subject: English
passage: To protect themselves from harsh winter conditions, many arctic foxes ______ their thick white coats during the coldest months. This adaptation provides essential insulation that can mean the difference between survival and death in sub-zero temperatures.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is finite and nonfinite verb forms within a sentence. A main clause requires a finite verb to perform the action of the subject (in this case, "foxes"), and this choice supplies the clause with the finite present tense verb "grow" to indicate how the foxes develop their winter coats.
